summary.intent: Get a status picture of the callisto repo (local files, PRs, Entire history), then continue the work by landing the local v1 implementation (T01-T05/T11) as a clean stack of commits.
summary.outcome: Produced a full status report and, after the user approved a 5-layer crate-based stack, began committing the four code layers (model, manifests, graph, cli) by explicit path while excluding tool settings. The docs/changesets layer, per-layer cargo check, full `just ci`, rebase onto main, and push were not yet done in this transcript.

repo: Branch work/v1-implementation-stack is 4 commits ahead of origin/main with no PR; about 83 dirty files (~7.6k lines) cover T02-T05 work plus 10 untracked changesets and untracked V1-FINDINGS.md, V1-VERIFICATION.md and how-callisto-works.md.
Cargo.lock +368 lines (36 new packages) comes from the new `jsonschema = "0.53"` dev-dependency in callisto-cli, used for JSON-schema tests.
version.rs, release.rs, lib.rs, runner.rs, cascade.rs and CLI e2e test files carry hunks from several changesets, so a per-topic commit split would need hunk-level patch surgery.
docs/projects/ROAD-TO-V1.md has 24 work units in 5 stages; its baseline (8ef9aa5a4, 'awaiting merge') and Stage 1 are stale since 0.9.0 and 0.10.0 shipped.
V1-VERIFICATION.md reports component-wise checks passing (1,862 tests, Clippy, 93.45% coverage, 25 release-workflow suite cases), but aggregate `just ci` hit a sandbox lock in cargo-deny.
Local commit T01 (verify generated decisions and applied PR heads) may overlap with merged #170, which fixed the same verify step on main; this was not confirmed.
workflow: Dirty tree contained tooling edits that must not be committed: .entire/settings.json (push_sessions true, push_checkpoints enabled, on a public repo whose session transcripts should stay private), .claude/settings.json (SubagentStop hook) and .gemini/settings.json (136 lines deleted). Stage by explicit path to exclude them.

A layered-by-crate stack (model, manifests, graph, cli, then docs/changesets) is a practical alternative to per-topic commits when changes are interleaved, with `cargo check` after each layer and full CI at the tip.
Confirm with the user before pushing; the user approved the stack plan but not yet a push.

friction: Interleaved hunks across the 10 changesets made a clean per-topic commit split impractical.
Aggregate `just ci` couldn't run green because of a sandbox lock in cargo-deny, so verification is only component-wise.
Entire tooling noise (settings changes, hooks out of date, legacy shadow branch) pollutes the dirty tree and status checks.
open_items: Commit layer 5 (changesets, specs, architecture docs, ROAD-TO-V1, README, verification docs) and verify cargo check per layer.
Run full `just ci` on the tip, rebase onto current main, and check overlap with #170 for T01.
Push as a native `gh stack` after user confirmation.
Refresh ROAD-TO-V1.md baseline and Stage 1 status.
Stages 3-5 not started: D01 owner-contract checkpoint, T06-T09 model changes, T10 generated workflows, T12 onboarding integration.

Loose ends: Sep 27 stash 'Callisto v1 work before origin/main sync', 174 Entire checkpoints not on origin, Entire hooks out of date (`entire enable --force`), one legacy shadow branch (`entire doctor`), stale origin branches fix/native-resolution, fix/release-forge-lookup, fix/release-pr-verify-envelope and docs/spec-rewrite.
Decide what to do with the three excluded tooling settings files (.entire, .claude, .gemini) left uncommitted.
